history.summary: A Divya Desam and one of the Pancharanga Kshetrams on the banks of the Kaveri, revered by Thirumangai Alvar in the Nalayira Divya Prabandham. The 12-ft presiding deity of green stone is in Anantasayana (reclining) posture facing east; five-tiered rajagopuram, three prakarams, shrines to Yoga Narasimhar, Rama, Anjaneya, Surya and Chandra. Legend says Parimala Ranganathar appeared here for Chandra (the moon god) to relieve him of his curse - 'Tiruindaloor' derives from this. CSV TOWN FLAG: the temple stands in Thiruvilandur (Indalur), a locality of Mayiladuthurai town; CSV row lists Mayiladuthurai.
